review_text: I visited mainly because of the co-working space. The food was okay, but I had to wait in line for a while since only one counter was open. I paid for my meal, coffee, and the hourly co-working fee (around ₱35, if I remember correctly), then stayed for about eight hours to complete my work shift. Unfortunately, the co-working area was disappointing. The room wasn’t well maintained, the chairs and tables were messy, and you could still hear noise from outside, which made it difficult to focus. Considering there’s an additional hourly fee, I expected a cleaner and quieter environment. Overall, I didn’t find the co-working space worth paying extra for. In my opinion, sitting in the regular dining area would have provided almost the same experience.

I was looking for a hangout spot early in the morning and was glad to find Barok Cafe, which is open 24 hours. The place is spacious and has a comfortable setup with wifi, power sockets, and areas suitable for both dining and working. I ordered an iced coffee during my visit, which was okay. However, there were quite a number of flies during my visit, which affected the overall experience. To add, considering I only ordered a latte, it also took quite some time to be prepared, which was a bit unexpected for a simple order.

I love the place's vibe, pleasing to eyes, windows were enough to get sunlight, although some areas doesn't reach the aircondition so we have to move from one seat to another. We have some orders not being available, but goodthing the second option is in so it's not really a big deal. The food served just right on waiting time. Coffee is smooth, rich, and full-bodied. The food deserves to be devoured too! Would definitely comeback!

I recently visited Barok Café and tried their Pamahaw Latte. Unfortunately, it wasn’t my favorite coffee experience in Davao. The flavor just didn’t suit my personal taste — though it might simply not be the kind of drink for me. That said, I really appreciated the ambiance of the place. The space is nice and has a cozy vibe that makes it comfortable to stay and relax. One thing I hope they can improve on is the serving time. It took quite a while for my drink to arrive, and I even had to follow up on my order despite the café not being busy at that time. Overall, while the drink didn’t work for me, the atmosphere is pleasant. Hoping for a smoother experience next time.

I had a great time here! The space is perfectly sized for group hangouts with friends—never felt cramped. What really stands out is the menu; it’s incredibly diverse with options that work for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. Highly recommended!

Our first time to this location of Barok Cafe and Resto was good as we expected. We have been to their other location many times since we live close to it. The place was clean even though they were busy on a Thursday evening when we went. It is roomy and there areas for groups to reserve for meetings, parties, etc. We were greeted by staff and given menus. We ordered the Hawaiian Pizza and the Bacon Parmesan Salad. Our wait time was reasonable and it was just as we hoped. The salad had good textures and flavors and paired well with the pizza. Our pizza had just the right amount of cheese, pineapple and ham and the crust thin and cooked well. A great dining experience!

I recently tried your Blueberry Cheesecake, but I was disappointed with the taste. The base didn’t taste like cheesecake—it seemed more like it had gelatin or resembled an egg tart. The blueberry topping was also too watery. You might want to consider changing your supplier. For a price of over ₱200, I expected to taste more cream cheese, but it just wasn’t there. Honestly, it was disappointing. I’ve had better-tasting cakes from Green Coffee at around ₱130. As for the matcha, I also find it overpriced. The taste doesn’t match the price—it feels like something that should cost around ₱49. You may want to consider upgrading the quality of your ingredients. At the end of the day, no matter how expensive a product is, customers are willing to pay if it’s worth it. But if it’s overpriced and unsatisfying, it will only lead to disappointment and discourage repeat purchases. This is an honest review, and I hope you take it into consideration. Thank you.

Parking here is limited, though they do offer additional paid parking nearby. On the night we visited, they seemed to be out of everything we ordered. We tried to be accommodating and changed our order several times, but to my surprise, they didn’t have anything we wanted. Since the place is open 24/7, you’d expect them to be better prepared. After several attempts, we gave up and went to the restaurant across the street. I’d be open to giving them another try in the future to see what they actually offer.

Big thanks to the staff and crew of Barok Cafe & Resto! We truly appreciate your warm assistance, best accommodation, and the helpful advice you gave to make sure our event went smoothly. You made us feel well taken care of, and we’re grateful for all your effort.
Spacious table set ups ideal for large group dining. Order serving time takes a bit long and is a bit pricey. 1 star less for parking unavailability. Consumes time to look for a parking area.

I had a wonderful experience at Barok Cafe & Resto. The food is impressive, especially considering the reasonable prices. I particularly enjoyed the pasta, chicken wings, and fries—each dish was flavorful and satisfying. Their coffee and pastries are also noteworthy, making it a great spot for both meals and light snacks. The restaurant itself is clean and cozy, offering a comfortable and inviting ambiance whether you're dining in alone or with friends. One of the highlights for me is that Barok Cafe & Resto operates 24 hours, which is a rare and much-appreciated convenience in Davao City. I’m genuinely glad to have discovered this place. If you’re looking for a spot that offers quality food, a relaxing atmosphere, and round-the-clock service, I highly recommend giving this restaurant a try.

Barok Café & Resto is a mix of coffee shop, restaurant and events place. There’s plenty of food and drinks in their menu since they are open from sun up to sun down, a real 24-hour store. This is my first time in Barok Café & Resto and It felt weird because half of place was a bit cozy, while the other half is just loud and noisy. The place looks like a barn house, yet the décor is a mix of everything. It’s like an unkept house. Since we already had our dinner a Roadhouse Cafe, we decided to try their coffee and cake, instead. The slices are a bit small, and not what we were used to in other coffee shops. The vanilla drink was filled up to the brink of the mug and the taste is just okay, passable to say the least. Crème Brulee Cake - P200.00 San Rival Cake - P190.00 Barok Vanilla 10oz - P170.00 I am not sure if I wanted to come back since I did not like the vibe, it was just too loud for my liking. Nothing feels really cozy about this place.

I went to Barok Café & Resto and the ambiance is amazing! They even have a co-working space, perfect for students and VAs — truly the best place to study and work. 🍴 The food is very affordable yet super delicious — definitely worth the price! 🤝 The service crew are so hospitable and friendly, it feels like you’re just hanging out with your own friends while waiting for your order. I also visited their Magallanes branch, and I was surprised because no matter which branch you go to, the staff are consistently very accommodating. Big salute to Barok Café & Resto!

Me and my friends only had coffee there. And they were super sweet for our liking. As far as I can remember we ordered iced mocha, americano, and Spanish latte. The CR looks big when entering but cramped on the cubicles - this is for the girls' Cr ha As for the overall atmosphere, the place is cool and it looks good. But it's too noisy for me. I had a glance of their co-working space and I really do think 80 pesos per hour is too much. Okay lang Sana if may privacy ka talaga like just you in one room jud.

The place is very pleasing and has a nice, cozy atmosphere. The staff were friendly and accommodating, which made the visit enjoyable. Unfortunately, they weren’t accepting online payments at the time due to some system issues, but they allowed me to step out and withdraw cash, which I appreciated. The pizza and drinks were really good and definitely worth the price, but the wait time for the pizza was quite long. Overall, still a good experience, and I’d consider coming back.

Food was great and the atmosphere was nice! Just a small setback with the service... They don’t take orders by table, which is fine, but if that’s the case, it would help to have more cashiers. There’s currently only one, so expect a bit of a line.

Went there during the soft opening. The place was a little bit chaotic. Some staff were just standing around, looking like they didn’t know what to do. They served our drinks in plastic cups while everyone else had glasses — we asked why, but they refused to answer???????? The food was pricey and didn’t match the taste for its price. Their coffee was good. The place is spacious, so it’s good for friends and family — but only because of the space.

The place is nice but they forgot our order🥲 lagpas 1 hour na when nag follow up kame and they literally don’t have our number sa kitchen. Then they reasoned out na naubos ingredients so we have to choose another dish. We end up leaving and not finishing our food because of disappointment. Imagine it di kame nag follow up sa order, gosh.

Strategically found within the vicinity encircled with office buildings. Fit for group gatherings as there are also function rooms and some parking. Music was too loud and could have been taken down a few notches. Chicken mushroom steak and matcha drink were just swift for dine-in food. Takeaways of chicken adobo, bangus sisig, chicken chopseuy, and pork sigang were familiar usuals you can find anywhere. It’s a self-service restaurant with inattentive staff and flies hovering while eating.

Staff: Some of the staff aren’t doing much, just using their phones. Might as well help around serving food. They should also probably only apply self service for drinks and let the staff handle the food in terms of serving. They also did not have the etiquette to hand us the menu after we found our seats, we had to go to the counter and get them ourselves. Food: Food was, meh, well for the barok adobo at least. I was not expecting it to just be chicken wings with adobo sauce they might as well name the item “barok adobo WINGS” with the presence of wings and the absence of any other chicken part. Would not recommend goinghere.

I only went here because Totsy’s was still closed one morning. I’ve actually eaten here twice already— my god, it’s still the same, nothing changed. The place is really hot. The food is very mediocre, and the pasta serving is way too small, not worth the price at all. The second time I came, there were flies that would actually land on the table. The restroom smelled really bad. The power outlets, although not all of them, were very loose and couldn’t even hold a charger. I definitely won’t be coming back here.
the aglio olio pasta i ordered is really not worth it for its price. so bland price like 70pesos and the garlic bread? you can discribe it eating like a rock so hard to eat not edible :(
Love my dinner at Barok Premium and Resto . All the staff very accommodating and kind. Highly recommended 😊🍔🍕🍽🍰

My girl and I went and man it was dirty like why?? We had to call the waiter to clean it up. But portion is good. Service is questionable. I would go back to the Phillipines to see if they still leave a mess. Thanks though!

If you’re craving hearty Filipino comfort food and a cozy dining vibe, Barok Cafe and Resto is the place to go! 💙 From classic dishes to flavorful specialties, every meal is satisfying and made with care. 🍲🥩 The restaurant offers a casual and welcoming ambiance, perfect for families, barkadas, or even a quick meal with friends. 🌿 The staff are friendly and attentive, making each visit enjoyable and stress-free. 🌞 What makes Barok Cafe and Resto stand out is its affordable prices, generous servings, and warm atmosphere, making it a favorite for locals and visitors alike. 🌟 For anyone who loves good food, cozy vibes, and a friendly place to eat, Barok Cafe and Resto is definitely worth a visit! 🥢✨

I'm giving this restaurant a -10000/10 and that's being generous. My experience was thoroughly disappointing.Firstly, the service was excruciatingly slow. We waited a full hour for our food, and when it finally arrived, it was cold. There's simply no excuse for serving cold food after such a long wait; I wasn't expecting it to be piping hot, but at least warm. This indicates a serious lack of attention to detail and efficiency in the kitchen.Secondly, the ambiance was terrible. The restaurant was extremely crowded, making it uncomfortable and difficult to even have a conversation. It was far from a relaxing or enjoyable dining environment.Overall, this was a disastrous dining experience. The combination of slow service, cold food, and an unpleasant atmosphere makes this a place I cannot recommend. I will not be returning.

Food- Went here twice may langaw inside 😔 shrimp gambas and bangus sisig was good but i do not recommend their chicken. Fried chicken wings was so so their adobo was made out of chicken wings. Self service restaurant and mabagal ang pila sa counter since sinusulat nila ang orders. Wifi- connection was slow i don't recommend if you need stable internet connection. Place- overall the place was cozy, good lighting perfect for catching up and if you want to read a book or watch Netflix.

Barok Café & Resto did not disappoint! 😍 Great vibes, friendly staff, spacious place, and food that’s both delicious & affordable. Perfect spot to chill, study, or bond with friends! 🍴☕✨” “First time at Barok Café & Resto and I’m impressed! 💯 Super warm staff, cozy + spacious ambiance, and budget-friendly meals that taste amazing. “If you’re looking for the best place to hang out, study, or eat good food without breaking the bank — Barok Café & Resto is the spot! 😍👌 Affordable food, amazing taste, spacious place, and the friendliest staff — that’s Barok Café & Resto for you! 💕🍴☕ “Shoutout to my friend for recommending Barok Café & Resto! 🙌 Super good food + good vibes = perfect combo! 😍 #MustTry”

I am writing to express my disappointment with the poor service I received at your restaurant on September 19, 2025 (Thursday) at 7.50 am. As a regular customer who has usually enjoyed dining at The Barok Café & Resto, I was surprised by the issue that occurred during my most recent visit. The main complaints were delayed service and unprofessional staff. Despite bringing these concerns to the attention of the staff, their response was useless and unprofessional. The restaurant buzzer system that had been given to me still not calling after waited 30 minutes. I decided to follow up with your staff named Vince and he said he will check it. At the same time, I go to the counter to check the status of my order, and I saw it still hanged on the counter. During that time there is one male staff just sitting down and Vince immediately prepared my cappuccino. I told the casher that I want all my order to be packed out since I am waiting for so long. Secondly, non or your staffs say “sorry” and I believe that as a customer, I deserved a certain level of service and professionalism, which I did not received. I hope that my feedback will encourage you to address these issues and improve the service quality for future customers. I look forward to your prompt response regarding this matter. Thank you for your attention. Sincerely, Faizel

Food was mediocre. Pizza was even not cooked properly. There's also the staff na very unwelcoming (except yung isang kuya na very friendly), the cashier was even paying more attention sa cellphone nya than assisting and getting our orders. Nakakaabala ata kami sa pagsosocmed nya😓 And for the price range, self service??? Like huh ano yun. May pa vip lounge smth pa tas self service pala lol. Not rlly recommended. Will definitely tell people abt this horrible experience.

Barok Cafe & Resto is a great spot for those seeking hearty Filipino meals in a comfortable environment. Whether you're a local or a traveler, it's a place worth checking out. ✅ Ambiance: Offers a relaxed and casual setting, suitable for both solo diners and groups ✅ Cuisine: Serves a variety of affordable and delicious Filipino dishes, catering to local tastes ✅ Beverages: Offers a selection of coffee and other beverages to complement meals

The system of their co-working space is weird. You have to give a ₱100 cash deposit, and youre not allowed to pay for one hour, it has to be a minimum of 2 hours. They dont have three-pronged outlets. But their service is good and the servers are very friendly and accommodating. The system is just very money-grabbing vibes.

Awful service. Requested for milk on the side for my brewed as I usually do in other coffee shops. Staff asked me to pay for it claiming that if I wanted milk, I should’ve ordered a latte. Absurd. Since I didn’t want this to ruin my day, I asked for creamer instead. They don’t have it either. And despite repeated request for milk just to make the coffee palatable, all fell on deaf ears. All they can say is they were instructed not to provide milk unless it’s paid for. While I and another customer (whose request for milk was also denied) were discussing about this unusual policy, the crew were just there chatting with zero effort to appease. There are hundreds of other coffee shops in the city where you will get your money’s worth. AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COST.

We had a very disappointing experience at this restaurant. We waited for over an hour for our food, only to find out that they hadn’t even started cooking our order. What made it worse was how the staff handled the situation they acted like we were the problem and responded with attitude instead of an apology. We were patient and understanding at first, but the service was completely unprofessional. Definitely not coming back, and I wouldn’t recommend it to others looking for a good dining experience.

So the prices are extremely high for a place not getting taxed . I ordered the chicken adobo and it was full of wings . Just a few actual meat . Not recommended and not gonna visit again . Thanks but no thanks

Highly recommend this coffee to visit.

The drinks were good, and the ambience and the place itself are beautiful. Unfortunately, that was the only positive part of our visit. The staff were not attentive or welcoming, and the customer service was disappointing. The food service was also poor, with long waiting times and an overall lack of organization. Parking is another major issue. Since the establishment is located along the main road, it becomes very difficult to stop or find a parking space once the place is full. Overall, the experience did not meet my expectations, and I hope the management improves both their customer service and parking arrangements.

The food at Barok was good, but the service was disappointingly slow. We waited a long time before our order arrived, even though the restaurant was not that busy. We ordered our food at 2:29am and it was served to us exactly 3AM. I hope they can improve their serving time because the overall dining experience would be much better with faster service.

We recently booked one of the conference rooms at Barok Cafe & Resto for four consecutive days to conduct a professional training session. While the staff were accommodating and the venue itself was pleasant, our experience was significantly affected by the lack of soundproofing between the conference rooms. Throughout our training, we could clearly hear conversations, discussions, and activities from neighboring rooms, making it difficult for our participants to stay focused. This isn't a criticism of the other customers—they were simply using the rooms they had reserved. The issue lies with the facility itself. If multiple conference rooms are expected to operate simultaneously, they should provide enough sound isolation so that one group's meeting doesn't interfere with another's. For anyone planning to hold trainings, workshops, or meetings that require concentration, this is something to keep in mind. We hope management considers improving the conference room setup because the location has potential, but the current noise issue makes it difficult to recommend for professional events.
Delicious food with amazing flavors in every bite! I truly enjoyed the meal and would definitely come back for more. Highly recommended!
I liked it here, the food is good as well as their cakes.

Personally, I really liked the couch setup on some of the tables. It made the place feel super comfy while waiting for our orders. So far, my favorites were their pork sisig and the blueberry-banana shake, I forgot the exact name haha. Service was fast, and the staff were very helpful. Before I left, I also noticed that the place seems to have an inclusive workspace for their employees, which I really appreciate. Overall, it was a nice experience and I’d definitely come back.

First time eating here and tried their baby back ribs. The buffalo flavor was delicious from the first bite. The ambiance of the place is also cool because there is a coworking space, eating tables and vip rooms for special meetings. This is not for budgetarians because their foods and drinks are expensive here.

269 Pesos for their Carbonara is as much as Jollibee Spag in the super meal. Then it's sweet. They put it on an aesthetic and big plate to make it worth it. Their coffee is overpriced and tasteless. I wish before we establish cafes/restaurants, we would think about the taste of the food and drinks. It's not just about making a business out of an aesthetic cafe.

Tho understood that yes there would be more consideration next time, I also feel embarrassed by other customers who scold my child who is already tantruming inside the cafe. Drinks were great. Ambience and the place itself are beautiful. The parking however is a little diff It's difficult when they get full because they're just opposite the main rd and it's hard to stop. but overall the staff was great, especially the one assigned to several parking lots.

If you are looking for a place around downtown where you can relax and be satisfied with it’s not so pricey menu I highly recommend this cafe & resto!💯 They are open 24hrs. The ambiance of the place is very relaxing (not the usual store that is common now) plus the food is reasonable for its price🫶🏻 Plus points also for the staff who are very welcoming, like even if they are doing something the moment you enter the store they will all greet you💓
